text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О
text_block_list.text:
— We've returned in a bakushin……!! 
Hoh! While we were running through 
the country the cherry blossoms have…!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It shows how many places we visited on
the way! Hehe, it's been a fun journey♪

text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О
text_block_list.text:
It has! And I'm certain many people all
throughout the country have had a lot of
fun as well…!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes! Let us have a little peek at just how much people have enjoyed themselves!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О
text_block_list.text:
If we simply look at the comments left
on the videos I have posted about our
adventures on Umatter…!

!? Them bakushin lassies were over in
me hometown!!? An' thems lookin' like
havin' a belly full a laughs as well ^^)
Oh, the joys!

I was pretty down about the lack of
hanami, but having Chiyo and friends
come over cheered me right up!!

Everybody'd been waitin' for the Sakura
trio to come on over from the far south…
It almost be like the actual cherry
blossom front, hahaha.

text_block_list.name: Сакура Тиёно О
text_block_list.text: There are so many comments…! And even more neighces and rehonses!

text_block_list.name: Сакура Бакушин-О
text_block_list.text: Mmm! I'd say it's been a great success!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: A grand victory, huh… Then it's time for that, wouldn't you say?
